definition.given: An administrator is viewing draft intervention FI1007-0002 for Indian SAS. Its Pres line has a pencil edit control, and the card offers enabled Validate, Clone, and Delete actions.
definition.when: Click the pencil beside the Pres line to edit that existing line.
definition.observed: Clicking the Pres line pencil opens the line editor with Save and Cancel. Validate, Clone and Delete remain visibly enabled record-level links below the active editor. The replay establishes the conflicting action availability, but does not demonstrate discarded edits or execution of those commands. Only the intervention card was exercised.
definition.require: While an existing intervention line is being edited, keep Save and Cancel available and make the record-level Validate, Clone and Delete commands non-actionable.
allow: The three record-level commands may be hidden or visibly disabled while the line editor is active.
Control placement, styling and localized labels may differ; Save and Cancel must remain available.

theory.title: Designing Interfaces, Third Edition: Contextual Actions and Commands
theory.reference: Jenifer Tidwell, Charles Brewer, and Aynne Valencia, Designing Interfaces, Third Edition; Chapter 8: Actions and Commands. Conceptual application based on chapter synthesis.
theory.rationale: Command availability should match the current object and editing state. The active line-editing task should offer completion or cancellation without also offering conflicting record-level transitions.

theory.title: Designing Interfaces, Third Edition: Continuity and Preservation of Unfinished Work
theory.reference: Jenifer Tidwell, Charles Brewer, and Aynne Valencia, Designing Interfaces, Third Edition; Chapter 1: Designing for People. Conceptual application based on chapter synthesis.
theory.rationale: A focused editing state should preserve unfinished work until it is saved or cancelled. Restricting conflicting commands makes that state understandable and predictable.

reference_observation: Opening the existing Pres line editor shows Save and Cancel. The intervention-level Validate, Clone, and Delete commands are absent while the editor is active.
requirement_rationale: A service line records description, date and duration within an intervention. Finishing or cancelling that edit before changing the whole record prevents conflicting actions on unfinished work.
